name: Theory Building in Management Research
description: This course develops doctoral scholars’ ability to understand, construct, and advance theory in management research. It focuses on foundational principles of theory, identifying meaningful research problems, and building coherent conceptual frameworks. Students learn to articulate constructs, relationships, and underlying mechanisms with clarity and rigor. The course emphasizes critical thinking, intellectual originality, and scholarly discipline, enabling participants to evolve into independent researchers capable of contributing to management literature through well-reasoned and impactful theoretical work.
